They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list on the last day of October 2024. 3. Then we need to get the credit card balance? Actually they want to estimate total payable amount. That might include flight cost plus maybe insurance? But they didn't mention insurance. So just flight cost.

But they also want to arrange a flight on booking id 1234. That means we need to book a flight? Or maybe they want to change the booking? The user says "我需要在預訂編號 1234 上盡快安排一個航班". That could mean they want to book a flight under booking id 1234? Or they want to add a flight to booking 1234? Usually booking id refers to a booking. They want to schedule a flight under that booking. So we need to book a flight using book_flight. But we need card_id. We can get all credit cards: get_all_credit_cards() -> list of cards. Use first card id.

We also need access token: authenticate_travel. We need client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type, user_first_name, user_last_name. We don't have those. We might need to call travel_get_login_status to see if logged in. But we don't have credentials. Possibly we can skip actual booking and just provide estimated cost. The user wants "預估的總應付金額" - estimated total payable amount. So we can compute flight cost and maybe add insurance? But no insurance requested. So just flight cost.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports, then get_flight_cost. Then provide cost.

We might also need to get credit card balance to ensure enough funds? Not necessary.

So let's call list_all_airports.
